INSERT INTO productVariants (productId, printfulVariantId, name, retailPrice, currency, size, color, inStock)
SELECT p.id, 2580, CONCAT(p.name, ' - Black / S'), 5500, 'USD', 'S', 'Black', 1 FROM products p WHERE p.name = 'Swarm Hoodie' ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
